tools.heading: Proven tools, chosen for the job

entries.a: Dooster is a UK technology-led digital studio. We design and engineer websites, manage social media and digital marketing, and use AI and data to help businesses get found on Google and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT. Clients include TraderMade and Kingfisher House Business Centre.

entries.q: How do you help businesses show up in AI search?
entries.a: We make sure AI crawlers can read your site, structure pages so they answer the questions buyers ask, add accurate structured data, and keep facts about your business consistent across the web. This is often called AEO or GEO. We then track whether AI assistants mention you.

entries.q: How long does a typical engagement take?
entries.a: A focused website project usually runs four to eight weeks. SEO, AI search and social media work is typically ongoing, with meaningful results building over three to six months.

entries.q: Do you work on a project or retainer basis?
entries.a: Both. Website builds and redesigns are usually fixed-scope projects. AI search, social media, email and analytics tend to work best as monthly retainers.

entries.q: Can you improve an existing site rather than build from scratch?
entries.a: Yes. If your site's foundations are sound, targeted work on speed, structure, content and AI search visibility is often the better investment. We'll tell you honestly which route makes sense.

entries.q: What kinds of businesses do you work best with?
entries.a: UK and international B2B, technology and service businesses that sell considered purchases, where buyers research, compare and ask questions before they enquire. Our clients include a financial market data provider and a business centre.

entries.q: What does the first conversation look like?
entries.a: A 30-minute call about your goals and where things feel stuck. If you've requested a free AI visibility check, we'll walk you through the results. No hard sell.

cta.heading: Ready to build something that performs?
cta.body: Whether it's a new website, marketing that's lost momentum, or making sure AI assistants recommend you, we'll show you what we'd do first.
